note: Eat-once learning (EARLY_GAME_PRINCIPLES 5): a character remembers which foods harmed them. first_hour_s is online seconds of protection for a new character: an unknown harmful food then costs only food and water (first_hour_cost), never sickness or health. A food that harmed before is stopped once with a hint; a second press within confirm_window_s eats it anyway.
say_first_hour: That did not sit right, but you got away with it. Now you know.
say_warn: That made you ill before. Press again to eat it anyway.
